rows: **Sefer**
Distinguish attested 22-letter inventory, 221/231 counting traditions, and proposed cube/Fano realization
Letter classes and their traditional names
**SOL**
Store cube and Fano as separate typed relational models; preserve both viable involutions; prevent counts from masquerading as genealogical operations
Existing candidate orientations unless contradicted
**SUN**
No change to mathematical operators; reject any attempt to infer a SUN interval from a bare cube count
No selected exceptional fiber follows from cube/Fano; no forced index bijection
$\mathbb Z_{12}\times\mathbb Z_3\times\mathbb Z_2$
**Shem**
Explicitly prohibit automatic identification of its three textual rows with Sefer's three mothers
Three 72-letter rows, middle reversed, 72 columns, 216 character positions
**TOL**
Keep later 22-path diagrams distinct from Sefer's letters and from cube edges
Ten sefirot and the selected diagram's documented path conventions
**Chinese music**
No new note or tuning rule; retain its own fifth-generation sequence and native correspondences
Chinese branch ratios and tuning history
**Western music**
No reassignment of diatonic/chromatic classes to cube vertices without evidence
Existing interval systems and comma
**Monochord / Completed Harmony**
May display candidate transformations on a shared ratio scale, but cannot derive pitches from binary labels alone
Actual length/frequency proportions; Fludd and Kepler remain distinguishable
**Genealogical classes**
Distinguish generation, partition, pairing, activation, and change of reference
Source-attested parentage and member order
**Cubehedron topology**
Treat cube as local finite incidence geometry, not automatically the global covering space
Existing class/register-lift hypotheses
**Files / atlas**
Add typed candidate records and explicit failures; do not overwrite native source representations
Existing source artifacts and frozen contracts
